description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police officer in his late 30s. He wears a sharp, formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, visible insignia on the shoulders, and a matching peaked cap. He has a clean-cut appearance with short black hair and a groomed mustache. He is wearing polished black leather boots.

FULL BODY. An elderly Malaysian man in his late 60s. He has silver-grey hair and wears a traditional short-sleeved batik shirt with a modern geometric pattern in shades of red. He wears loose-fitting dark trousers and simple leather sandals. He has a kind, gentle face with visible wrinkles around the eyes.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette representing a digital threat. The figure is solid matte black with a faint glowing blue circuit-pattern outline pulsing across the torso. The figure has no facial features and is wearing a dark, nondescript hooded cloak that obscures any physical form.
